svg.title: amp Lyrics view for Idioteque by Radiohead
svg.desc: Lyrics pushed view. Top chrome contains only a back button. Below is a yellow Lyrics brutalist block as the view title, then a centered context row in muted mono reading Idioteque middot Radiohead middot Kid A. The body contains eight lyric lines rendered as 18pt sans medium black text centered in each row. The fifth line And the children is highlighted as a full-width navy-inversion strip with white bold text, indicating it is the currently-playing synced line. Bottom tab bar shows Library, Search, Queue, and Active with Active as the navy-inverted selected tab since Lyrics is pushed from Now Playing which lives on the Active tab.

g.text: I laugh until my head comes off
